review_story.summary: Shower eye shield (Spanish): if you do your brows and lashes, watch this — shampoo runs over a clear shield instead of your eyes; 'Comment QUIERO'.
review_story.hook: 'Si te haces las cejas y las pestañas, mira esto 👀' + woman under the shower looking up with water on her face.
highlights: 0–2s: audience call-out label names the exact customer (brow/lash users)
4.5–7s: demonstration shot: foam runs down over the shield, nothing touches the eyes
7.4s: question CTA '¿Lo probarías? Comenta QUIERO' over close-ups of her eyes
Ends on the benefit itself: intact lashes, eyes open
